option_relations.rationale: Nonischemic Dilated Cardiomyopathy does not match the specific findings of RV dilatation and dysfunction
Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy matches the described RV dilatation, dysfunction, and ECG findings
Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with biventricular involvement is a broader term that encompasses Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy
Ventricular Tachycardia due to ARVC is a possible manifestation of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy
